edges.to_entity: All 17 drained Binance hot wallets, including five XRPL accounts
edges.details: Bitquery explicitly states each drained wallet carries a Binance PoR label in its address data.
Approximately 233.5M XRP; receiver still held this amount at 06:43 UTC with no known exchange, mixer or bridge transfer by that cutoff.

edges.to_entity: Approximately 823M USDC in main Ethereum attacker receiver
edges.details: Reported at 21:04 UTC on October 29; Ethereum USDC only, not XRP/XRPL.
Bitquery reports 71% of the stolen USDT locked; about 729M USDT had already been swapped into ETH/TRX.

edges.to_entity: Some stolen USDT securing an ETH loan
edges.details: Amount and exact Aave deployment unspecified; no XRP collateral identified.
Ripple is among six issuers associated with about $132M aggregate freezes; do not infer RLUSD or XRP.
Bitquery links the drains to the wider incident by timing, transaction construction and Binance's aggregate, not a shared address.

disconfirming_evidence: Bitquery's PoR labels are provider address data, not a raw official Binance XRP export.
Circle's freeze was Ethereum USDC, not XRP or XRPL USDC.
Aave collateral was USDT with ETH debt, not XRP collateral.
Ripple's frozen token identity is unknown; no RLUSD attribution is justified.
The 06:43 UTC receiver balance is not current.
XRP/Solana share no address with other chain clusters.
